data.text: Luke, I’m not accepting 9 tons so you can take 14. Would you support 13 tons each for you and me, with 8 each for John, Kate, and Jack? That totals 50, leaving 50 to double back to 100 next month. We’d each earn $13,000 this month, and the others would each earn $8,000. That needs their agreement, not just ours. Would you back that proposal?
